timing_note: Timings are harness measurements, not kernel speedups. Timed work may differ between engines (including geometry extraction and cleanup); Rhino includes the Python/RhinoCommon bridge and any host emulation overhead. See docs/oracle.md#timing-interpretation.
matching_note: Unique nearest six-sample max-coordinate matches form a bijection in each wire set. Only reference array order changes; every sample and topology field is then checked by the standard comparator. This is not a general curve-distance or topology proof.
